about: House recipes, batch 04 (slice C): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Vegan Oat Porridge with Stewed Apple and Cinnamon
recipes.summary: Creamy oats cooked in soy milk with soft cinnamon apple, entirely plant-based.
steps: Simmer the apples with 2 tbsp of water and half the cinnamon for 6 minutes until soft.
Cook the oats with the soy milk and salt over medium heat for 6 minutes, stirring, until thick and creamy.
Spoon into bowls, top with the apple, maple syrup and walnuts.
notes: Use certified gluten-free oats for coeliacs.
Stewed apple keeps 4 days.

recipes.title: Gluten-Free Buckwheat Pancakes with Cinnamon Apple
recipes.summary: Light buckwheat flour pancakes with a sharp spoonful of cinnamon apple.

items: 1 tbsp butter, extra, for the pan

steps: Whisk the flour, baking powder, egg, milk and melted butter into a smooth batter and rest 5 minutes.
Simmer the apples with the honey, a pinch of cinnamon and 2 tbsp of water for 5 minutes until soft and syrupy.
Cook ladlefuls of batter in a buttered pan over medium heat for 2 minutes a side until golden and cooked through.
Stack the pancakes and spoon over the apple.
notes: Food safety: cook the pancakes until the centres are set and no longer wet, especially for pregnant women, older people and young children.
Check the buckwheat flour label if cooking for coeliacs.

recipes.title: Vegan Chickpea Flour Pancakes with Spinach and Tomato
recipes.summary: Savoury besan pancakes cooked with spinach and cherry tomatoes, no egg or dairy.
steps: Whisk the chickpea flour, water, turmeric, cumin and salt into a smooth batter and stir in the spinach.
Heat half the oil in a non-stick pan and pour in half the batter, scattering with tomatoes.
Cook for 3 minutes until the base is golden and the top is set, then flip and cook 2 minutes more until firm.
Repeat with the remaining oil and batter.
notes: Let the batter sit 10 minutes for a softer texture.
Serve with coconut yoghurt.

recipes.title: Tofu Scramble with Turmeric, Kale and Cherry Tomatoes
recipes.summary: Savoury crumbled tofu scramble with kale and cherry tomatoes, vegan and high in protein.
steps: Crumble the tofu into a bowl with your hands.
Heat the oil in a frying pan, add the tofu, turmeric and cumin and cook for 5 minutes until the edges colour and most of the water has gone.
Stir in the kale, tomatoes and soy sauce and cook for 3 minutes until the kale wilts.
Finish with the nutritional yeast and pepper.
notes: Serve on gluten-free toast with avocado.
Use tamari for gluten-free.

recipes.title: Gluten-Free Quinoa Breakfast Bowl with Cinnamon Pears
recipes.summary: Warm quinoa simmered in milk with spiced pears and toasted seeds.
steps: Simmer the quinoa with the milk and water for 15 minutes until soft and the liquid is mostly absorbed.
Cook the pears in a small pan with the cinnamon and 2 tbsp of water for 5 minutes until tender.
Spoon the quinoa into bowls, top with the pears, maple syrup and pumpkin seeds.
notes: Use oat or soy milk to make it vegan.
Quinoa keeps 4 days cooked for quick bowls.

recipes.title: Vegan Coconut Jasmine Rice Porridge with Lime and Mango
recipes.summary: Creamy coconut milk rice pudding, topped with fresh mango.
steps: Simmer the rice with the coconut milk, water and salt, stirring often, for 28 minutes until the rice is very soft and the pudding is thick.
Stir through the maple syrup.
Serve warm in bowls topped with the mango and toasted coconut.
notes: Stir often at the end to prevent sticking.
Thin with a splash of water if it thickens on standing.

recipes.title: Gluten-Free Polenta Porridge with Maple and Walnuts
recipes.summary: Soft, creamy cornmeal porridge sweetened with maple and topped with crunchy walnuts.
steps: Bring the water, milk and salt to a gentle simmer until steaming.
Whisk in the polenta in a thin stream and cook for 12 minutes, stirring often, until thick and no longer gritty.
Serve in bowls topped with maple syrup, walnuts and cinnamon.
notes: Use soy milk for dairy-free.
Leftovers set firm; slice and pan-fry.

recipes.title: Vegan Savoury Oats with Mushrooms and Soy
recipes.summary: Savoury rolled oats cooked in stock with fried mushrooms and spring onion.
steps: Fry the mushrooms in the oil over high heat for 5 minutes until golden and the liquid has gone.
Simmer the oats in the stock for 6 minutes, stirring, until thick and creamy.
Stir in the soy sauce, then top with the mushrooms, spring onion and sesame oil.
notes: Add a soft egg for non-vegan protein.
Use tamari and gluten-free oats for coeliacs.

recipes.title: Smoky Sweet Potato, Capsicum and Bean Hash, Vegan
recipes.summary: Crisp sweet potato cubes, black beans and capsicum with smoky paprika.
steps: Fry the sweet potato in the oil over medium heat for 15 minutes, turning, until tender and browned.
Add the capsicum, paprika, cumin and salt and cook for 5 minutes until softened.
Stir in the beans and cook for 3 minutes until hot.
Top with spring onion and avocado.
notes: Cover the pan for the first 5 minutes to soften the sweet potato faster.
Add a squeeze of lime.

recipes.title: Japanese Breakfast Rice Bowl with Soft Egg and Nori
recipes.summary: Warm rice topped with a soft-boiled egg, nori and soy for a quick Japanese-style breakfast.
steps: Boil the eggs for 6 1/2 minutes until the whites are set and the yolks soft, then cool in cold water and peel.
Divide the warm rice between bowls and drizzle with the sesame oil.
Top with the halved eggs, nori, spring onion, soy sauce and sesame seeds.
notes: Food safety: soft yolks carry a small salmonella risk; pregnant women, older people and young children should boil eggs until firm.
Cool leftover rice and refrigerate within 1 hour; reheat until steaming hot and eat within 1 day.

recipes.title: Mexican Breakfast Bowl with Black Beans, Eggs and Salsa
recipes.summary: Black beans, rice and fried eggs topped with fresh salsa and avocado.
steps: Warm the beans and rice together in a small pan for 3 minutes until hot.
Mix the tomato, onion, coriander, lime juice and salt for a quick salsa.
Fry the eggs in the oil over medium heat for 3 minutes until the whites are set and opaque.
Spoon the rice and beans into bowls and top with the eggs, salsa and avocado.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites are fully set; pregnant women, older people and young children should have yolks firm.
Add hot sauce to taste.

recipes.title: Turkish Menemen Breakfast Bowl with Yoghurt
recipes.summary: Soft scrambled eggs cooked in a pepper and tomato sauce, served over cool garlic yoghurt.
steps: Fry the capsicum in the oil for 4 minutes until soft.
Add the tomatoes and chilli and simmer for 6 minutes until thick and jammy.
Crack the eggs in and stir gently for 3 minutes until just set but still creamy and cooked through.
Spoon the yoghurt mixed with garlic and salt into bowls, top with the eggs and parsley.
notes: Food safety: cook eggs until fully set, especially for pregnant women, older people and young children.
Serve with crusty bread.

recipes.title: Savoury Masala Oats Bowl with Peas and Carrot
recipes.summary: Spiced savoury oats cooked with onion, peas and carrot, a quick Indian-style breakfast.
steps: Fry the cumin seeds in the oil for 30 seconds until they sizzle, then add the onion and cook 4 minutes until soft.
Add the carrot, garam masala and turmeric and cook for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Stir in the oats, water, peas and salt and simmer for 6 minutes, stirring, until thick.
Serve topped with coriander.
notes: Add a squeeze of lemon to brighten.
Use gluten-free oats for coeliacs.

recipes.title: Middle Eastern Shakshuka Grain Bowl
recipes.summary: Warm barley or rice topped with eggs poached in a spiced tomato sauce.
steps: Fry the onion and capsicum in the oil for 6 minutes until soft.
Stir in the cumin, paprika, tomatoes and salt and simmer for 8 minutes until thick.
Make two wells, crack in the eggs, cover and cook for 5 minutes until the whites are set.
Spoon the barley into bowls, top with the eggs and sauce, and scatter with parsley.
notes: Food safety: cook eggs until the whites are firm and the yolks are not runny for pregnant women, older people and young children.
Add feta if you like.

recipes.title: Vietnamese Egg and Pork Rice Breakfast Bowl
recipes.summary: Rice topped with a fried egg, savoury caramelised pork mince and fresh cucumber.
steps: Fry the pork mince with the garlic for 6 minutes, breaking it up, until browned with no pink left.
Stir in the fish sauce and sugar and cook for 2 minutes until sticky.
Fry the eggs in the oil for 3 minutes until the whites are crisp at the edges and set.
Serve the rice topped with the pork, eggs, cucumber and spring onion.
notes: Food safety: cook pork mince to 75°C throughout with no pink; cook eggs until whites are set, firm yolks for pregnant women, older people and young children.
Add chilli sauce.

recipes.title: Hangover Bacon, Egg and Cheese Brekkie Rolls
recipes.summary: Soft rolls stuffed with crisp bacon and a fried egg, a classic hangover fix.
steps: Fry the bacon in the oil for 5 minutes, turning, until crisp.
Fry the eggs in the same pan for 3 minutes until the whites are set and the yolks are cooked as you like.
Butter the rolls, fill with the bacon, eggs and cheddar until the cheese melts, and add the tomato sauce.
notes: Food safety: cook eggs until the whites and yolks are fully set for pregnant women, older people and young children; cook bacon until no pink remains.
Add a slice of cheese for extra comfort.

recipes.title: Hangover Fry-Up Tray Bake
recipes.summary: Sausages, bacon, tomatoes, mushrooms and eggs baked on one tray for an easy fry-up.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C and arrange the sausages and bacon on a large tray with the tomatoes and mushrooms, drizzled with oil.
Bake for 18 minutes, turning the sausages once, until golden and sausages are cooked through with no pink.
Make four gaps, crack in the eggs, and bake 6 minutes more until the whites are set.
Toast the bread until golden and serve with the tray bake and pepper.
notes: Food safety: cook sausages to 75°C throughout with no pink; cook eggs until fully set for pregnant women, older people and young children.
Add baked beans in a small ovenproof dish.

recipes.title: Hangover Cheesy Baked Beans on Toast with Fried Egg
recipes.summary: Hot baked beans melted with cheddar on buttered toast, topped with a fried egg.
steps: Warm the beans with the Worcestershire sauce in a saucepan for 4 minutes until bubbling, then stir through the cheddar until melted.
Fry the eggs in the oil for 3 minutes until the whites are set.
Butter the toast, spoon over the beans until generously covered and top with the eggs.
notes: Food safety: cook eggs until fully set for pregnant women, older people and young children.
Worcestershire sauce contains anchovy, so it is not vegetarian.

recipes.title: Hangover Ginger and Spring Onion Rice Congee
recipes.summary: A soothing rice porridge with fresh ginger, soy and a soft egg, easy on the stomach.
steps: Simmer the rice with the water and ginger, stirring now and then, for 30 minutes until the grains break down into a thick porridge.
Crack the eggs into the simmering congee and cook for 3 minutes until the whites are set.
Season with the soy sauce and pepper and serve topped with spring onion and sesame oil.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until firm for pregnant women, older people and young children.
Add shredded chicken to make it more filling.

recipes.title: Hangover Egg Drop Miso Soup with Rice
recipes.summary: Warm miso broth with ribbons of egg, tofu and a scoop of rice.
steps: Bring the water and dashi to a gentle simmer until steaming.
Dissolve the miso paste in a ladleful of the hot dashi, then stir it back into the pot without boiling.
Pour in the egg in a thin stream, stirring gently, and cook 1 minute until it forms ribbons and is set.
Add the tofu, heat for 1 minute until warm, and ladle over the rice with spring onion.
notes: Food safety: eggs are cooked fully set in the hot broth.
Dashi granules contain fish; use a kombu stock for vegetarian.

recipes.title: Hangover Spicy Egg Breakfast Burrito
recipes.summary: Scrambled eggs, beans, cheese and hot sauce wrapped in a warm tortilla.
steps: Warm the tortillas in a dry pan for 20 seconds each until pliable.
Melt the butter and scramble the eggs over medium heat for 3 minutes, stirring, until just set and cooked through.
Fill the tortillas with the eggs, beans, cheese, tomato and hot sauce.
Roll up tightly and toast in the pan for 1 minute a side until golden.
notes: Food safety: cook eggs until fully set for pregnant women, older people and young children.
Wrap in foil to take out.

recipes.title: Hangover Hash Brown Stack with Egg and Bacon
recipes.summary: Crisp potato hash brown topped with bacon, a poached egg and chives.
steps: Squeeze the grated potato dry in a cloth and mix with the salt.
Fry two large mounds in the oil for 6 minutes a side, pressing flat, until crisp and golden.
Cook the bacon in a pan for 5 minutes until crisp.
Poach the eggs in barely simmering water with the vinegar for 3 minutes until the whites are set, then stack on the hash browns with the bacon and chives.
notes: Food safety: cook bacon until no pink remains and eggs until whites are fully set for pregnant women, older people and young children.
Add hollandaise if you are brave.

recipes.title: Clear Chicken Stock from Roasted Bones
recipes.summary: A golden, clear chicken stock built from roasted bones, aromatics and a long, gentle simmer.
steps: Roast the chicken bones at 220°C for 35 minutes until deep golden.
Tip the bones into a large pot with the onion, carrot, celery, garlic, bay and peppercorns, and cover with the cold water.
Bring to a bare simmer over medium heat, skimming the scum, then reduce the heat so only a few bubbles break the surface.
Simmer uncovered for 3 hours, topping up with water if needed, until rich and golden.
Strain through a fine sieve, cool quickly and chill; lift the set fat off the top. Check the meat on the wings has reached at least 75°C.
notes: Food safety: the stock must simmer well above 75°C, cool within 2 hours and keep in the fridge for 3 days or freeze for 3 months; reheat until boiling hot.
Never salt the stock; season whatever you make with it.

recipes.title: Roasted Vegetable Stock with Leek and Mushroom
recipes.summary: A deeply savoury vegetable stock from roasted onion, leek, mushroom and herbs.
steps: Roast the onions, leeks, carrots, mushrooms and garlic with the oil at 220°C for 30 minutes until browned at the edges.
Tip into a large pot with the parsley, bay, peppercorns and water.
Bring to the boil, then simmer gently for 1 hour until the stock tastes rich and savoury.
Strain through a fine sieve and cool.
notes: Keeps 4 days in the fridge or 3 months frozen.
Skip the cabbage family; it turns the stock bitter.
